title: How do these pairs of line segments meet or cross?
description: Three pairs of line segments are drawn. The board describes each pair in mathematical words: one pair meets at an endpoint, and two pairs intersect at a point, with the angle between them. Keeko doubts that all three pairs intersect.
teaching_notes: One idea: segments that only touch at an end meet at an endpoint, and segments that cross each other intersect at a point. Watch for students who say two segments intersect because they touch.

source: Three pairs of line segments are drawn. FG and FH share the end F, with 115.3° between them. AB and CD cross at X, at about 60°. IJ and LM cross at Y, at about 80°. Describe each pair in mathematical words.
video_script.why: The child describes how pairs of segments meet or cross, using the words point, endpoint, midpoint, meet and intersect, and gives the angle.
video_script.substitution: The book's own figure of line segments: each pair is described with the mathematical words the book lists, and the degree measure of the angle is given, as in the book's example of the segments that meet at an endpoint.
video_script.anchor: Three pairs of line segments: F G and F H sharing the end F, A B and C D crossing at X, and I J and L M crossing at Y.
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks segments intersect whenever they touch.
video_script.payoff_line: The first pair meets at an endpoint, and the other two pairs intersect.

final_answer.value: FG and FH meet at the endpoint F at 115.3°; AB and CD intersect at X at about 60°; IJ and LM intersect close to both midpoints at about 80°
final_answer.spoken: F G and F H meet at the endpoint F at one hundred and fifteen point three degrees, eigh B and C D intersect at X at about sixty degrees, and I J and L M intersect close to both midpoints at about eighty degrees

hold_back: FG and FH meet at the endpoint F at 115.3°; AB and CD intersect at X at about 60°; IJ and LM intersect close to both midpoints at about 80°
maths_rules: FG and FH meet at the endpoint F, with 115.3 degrees between them
AB and CD intersect at the point X, at about 60, and X is not the midpoint of either segment
IJ and LM intersect at the point Y, at about 80, and Y is close to the midpoint of both segments
60 and 80 are measured values, so they are close values and not exact
the slip: FG and FH touch at an end and do not cross, so they meet but do not intersect
video_script.design: The three pairs of segments are drawn on the stage and stay all video. Each pair lights up in turn as the board describes it, with its angle marked.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Keeko thinks all three pairs intersect, because they all touch.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the first pair touches only at an end, and the segments do not cross each other.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Two segments intersect when they cross each other, so only the other two pairs intersect.
